question: Does bypassing the differentiable-path explicit FP8/FP4 activation roundtrips restore one-step descent under the original all40-layer recipe on the original 811-target Metal change?
scope: Single previously selected training row and one optimizer update; development/root-cause experiment, not independent quality evaluation.

intervention.control: activation_mode=checkpoint (existing explicit FP8/FP4 roundtrips with identity STE)
changed_operators: NativeLinear explicit input FP8 roundtrip outside FrozenIndexer (only where quantize_input was enabled)
Attention output FP8 roundtrip before wo_a groups
preserved: EXL3 expert bitstreams and native packed MXFP8/BF16 weights
Existing tensor dtypes and BF16 casts/additions
All FrozenIndexer projection-input quantizers and query/key FP4_E8M0 roundtrips
Freshly recomputed index selections and MoE routes on actual current activations
All custom VJP definitions except removal of bypassed quantizer nodes
Chunking/reduction order, row/mask/target IDs, LoRA scope and initialization, optimizer recipe
not_claimed: The new objective equals the checkpoint-mode objective
The model is smooth or free of quantization
Indexer route IDs remain identical across modes

matched_settings.initial_A: fresh seed8 initialization; verify bitwise equal to all original step1 A tensors, which did not update on first step
matched_settings.resource_exception_policy: If reserve/headroom or cache settings change, record resolved settings and prove unchanged math; never silently exceed authorized80GiB. Chunk size and activation mode are arithmetic settings, not resource overrides.

original_control.base_payload_identity_limit: Metadata/manifest hashes and file stat guards are not a full payload hash of every frozen weight byte.
original_control.reuse_gate: For a matched causal claim, current checkpoint mode must replay original zero-B and original saved-step supervised logits digests exactly (and NLL within1e-6) under the frozen new runtime. If either does not match, report historical control only and run a fresh same-runtime checkpoint-mode one-step control; do not discard the mismatch.

prelaunch_gates: Freeze a separate runtime source/dependency copy after activation/default/cache tests; record its final implementation identity and this protocol SHA256 in a new run plan. The source hashes below are a predeclaration snapshot, not evidence that later source is identical.
Verify exact one prepared row SHA256, token IDs, loss_start, supervised811 and no truncation; reuse the original prepared data directly.
Fresh model and fresh optimizer; no resume/resume-adapter, scalar adapter rescaling, route freezing, bias-correction change or precision rewrite.
Confirm mode checkpoint is the legacy default and all inference/training children use the declared mode; cross-mode adapter loading is rejected.
Complete numerical parity/default tests; do not launch concurrently with another GPU workload.
measurement_order: Fresh full uncached zero-B evaluation in treatment mode on the full811-target row; save loss, counts, target IDs/per-token NLL if enabled, supervised logits digest, resources, runtime/model/data identities.
Run exactly one full40-layer optimizer update using the matched settings; retain pre-update training loss, raw pre-clip gradient norm, one microbatch count, checkpoint and optimizer moments.

Audit all80 A tensors against the original step1 A tensors with exact dtype/shape/bit equality, and require their first-step Adam m/v zero. Verify every initial B was zero by construction and saved B/m/v finite. If an initial adapter artifact is available, audit it too; otherwise identify the first-step A/moment reconstruction as the evidence.

Fresh process loads the saved treatment-mode adapter and fully reevaluates the same complete row uncached; save counts/logits digest/per-token metrics. An in-process post-score may be additional evidence but does not replace fresh reload.

Compute per-mode loss deltas and first-order surrogate directional predictions from raw gradients plus actual saved parameter deltas. Retain both failed and successful outcomes; no post-hoc checkpoint/strength/LR selection in this primary trial.
Replay original control under the new frozen implementation before making a matched-causal claim; if replay fails run a new control and record why.

gradient_prediction.definition: Sum over trainable tensors of float64(g_raw * (theta_after-theta_before)); not an assertion that the nonsmooth forward obeys this linearization.
gradient_prediction.preferred_gradient: Saved raw pre-clip gradient if available.
gradient_prediction.first_moment_fallback: For fresh first-step Adam beta1=.9, saved m=.1*g_clipped. Reconstruct g_clipped=m/.1 in CPU float64. If clip active undo c=min(1,1/(logged_raw_norm+1e-6)); record the rounding approximation and cross-check reconstructed norm. Do not call m/.1 the raw gradient when clipping is active.
gradient_prediction.first_step_parameter_delta: B_after because B_before=0; A_after-A_before must be0. Use actual arrays instead of an idealized sign-step.
gradient_prediction.bias_confound: Keep default uncorrected Adam for both modes. Bias-corrected Adam changes effective first-step scale/epsilon; it is a separate declared experiment, not a correction applied only to the treatment.
gradient_prediction.sanity_gate: Finite moments/arrays; first update number1; A m/v exactly0; actual B matches uncorrected Adam from saved m/v within recorded FP32 tolerance. Do not infer derivative correctness just because g-dot-delta is negative.

predeclared_scoring.primary_metric: Token-weighted mean NLL across all811 assistant targets including EOS.
predeclared_scoring.inconclusive_band: Absolute delta <=1e-6; report no resolved change.
predeclared_scoring.training_baseline_gate: Pre-update train NLL must match fresh same-mode baseline within1e-6 (FP32 scalar reduction allowance). Otherwise stop the matched comparison and diagnose objective/data/mode mismatch.
predeclared_scoring.counts_gate: Exactly1 row and811 supervised targets; IDs equal the prepared row suffix. All scores and per-token values finite.
predeclared_scoring.secondary: Report predeclared added_code, added_comment, removed_code, unchanged_context, diff_header andEOS token-class NLL/argmax outcomes where available. Use fixed category artifact; no subset replaces the complete-row primary metric.
predeclared_scoring.interpretation: Compare delta within each mode. Do not use treatment-vs-control absolute baseline NLL as the learned improvement.

decision_rules: Control reproduces regression, treatment descends, A/data/optimizer/math-other-than-mode match: evidence that this combined differentiable-path activation intervention restores one-step training descent for this row/recipe.
Treatment descends but control parity is absent: useful treatment-mode fit result only; no matched causal attribution yet.
Both regress: proposed intervention did not fix one-step descent; retain failure, investigate remaining BF16/discrete routing/composition/optimizer hypotheses.
Both descend: current run does not reproduce the original failure under matched conditions; investigate control/source drift before attributing a fix.
A initialization or mask/optimizer differs: report confounded run; do not call it the original-recipe causal contrast.

Passing loss descent does not certify learned Metal optimization, autonomous patches, correctness or speedup; those require pinned-parent patch generation plus matching execution harness and lineage-separated tasks.
